title.en: Tale 20 — The Ascetic and the Mongoose

sentences.ar: قال بيدبا: وآخر حكاية، يا ملك، عن الاستعجال.
sentences.en: Bidpai said: and the last tale, my king, is about haste.

sentences.ar: كان في ناسك بيعيش بقرية زغيرة مع مرته.
sentences.en: There was an ascetic living in a small village with his wife.

sentences.ar: وقبل الولد، كان عندهم ابن عرس زغير، رباه الناسك من صغره.
sentences.en: And before the boy, they had a small mongoose, which the ascetic had raised from infancy.

sentences.ar: كان يمشي وراه بالبيت زي الكلب، وينام جنب الولد.
sentences.en: It followed him about the house like a dog, and slept beside the boy.

sentences.ar: قالت للناسك: خليك مع الولد، لا تتركه.
sentences.en: She said to the ascetic: stay with the boy, do not leave him.

sentences.ar: وبعد شوي، إجا حدا من القرية ونادى الناسك.
sentences.en: And a little later, someone from the village came and called the ascetic.

sentences.ar: قال: تعال بسرعة، في واحد بده يسمع كلامك.
sentences.en: He said: come quickly, there is someone who wants to hear your words.

sentences.ar: تطلع الناسك على الولد، كان نايم، وابن عرس جنبه.
sentences.en: The ascetic looked at the boy, who was sleeping, with the mongoose beside him.
